THE CALLER STATED THESE CHEMICALS HAVE ALSO BEEN DUMPED INTO DUMPSTERS TO BE PLACED IN LANDFILLS, AND ALSO THAT THE COMPANY IS BURNING UNKNOWN OILS, FOAM, RUBBER, AND CHEMICALS ON-SITE. CALLER STATED THAT AT LEAST THREE INDIVIDUALS HAVE GOTTEN SICK BECAUSE OF EXPOSURE TO THE CHEMICALS, AND AT LEAST ONE INDIVIDUAL WAS HOSPITALIZED. SYMPTOMS FOR THESE INDIVIDUALS INCLUDE DIFFICULTY BREATHING, DIZZINESS, LIGHT-HEADEDNESS.

HOWEVER, NO POINT SOURCE WAS IDENTIFIED, WINDS WERE NOT IDEAL AND THE ANOMALY WAS NEAR-SHORE. WINDS WERE OUT OF THE W AT 5 KT AT THE TIME OF THE IMAGE. Report DescriptionBLUF: WASHINGTON STATE FERRY (WSF) CATHLAMET ALLIDED WITH A DOLPHIN (PIER DOCKING STRUCTURE), RESULTING IN SIGNIFICANT DAMAGE TO THE VESSEL. NO INJURIES TO PASSENGERS OR CREW. DETAILS: SECTOR PUGET SOUND (SPS) RECEIVED A REPORT FROM SEATTLE PD AND THE WSF OPCEN OF AN ALLISION BETWEEN FERRY CATHLAMET AND A DOLPHIN AT THE FAUNTLEROY TERMINAL (SW SEATTLE) RESULTING IN SIGNIFICANT DAMAGE TO THE PORT SIDE OF THE SUPERSTRUCTURE. SEATTLE FD/PD ARRIVED ON SCENE AND DETERMINED THERE WERE NO INJURIES TO THE PASSENGERS OR CREW. SPS COMMAND CENTER CONFIRMED WITH WSF CAPTAIN ABOARD THE VESSEL. ALL PASSENGERS WERE EVACUATED FROM THE VESSEL, AND VEHICLES REMOVED AFTER SUCCESSFUL DOCKING AT THE FAUNTLEROY TERMINAL. 02 VEHICLES ON THE PORT SIDE REMAIN PINNED BY THE DAMAGED SUPERSTRUCTURE OF THE VESSEL. ALLISON WAS ABOVE THE WATERLINE, AND THERE IS NO POLLUTION AT THIS TIME. DOLPHIN IS ALSO SIGNIFICANTLY DAMAGED. FERRY REMAINS DOCKED AT THE FAUNTLEROY TERMINAL. CURRENT ESTIMATES ARE $500,000 OR GREATER IN DAMAGE ACCORDING TO THE PORT CAPTAIN FROM WSF, MEETING THRESHOLD FOR MAJOR MARINE CASUALTY. CASE PENDS.

DETAILS: SECTOR PUGET SOUND (SPS) RECEIVED A REPORT FROM SEATTLE PD AND THE WSF OPCEN OF AN ALLISION BETWEEN FERRY CATHLAMET AND A DOLPHIN AT THE FAUNTLEROY TERMINAL (SW SEATTLE) RESULTING IN SIGNIFICANT DAMAGE TO THE PORT SIDE OF THE SUPERSTRUCTURE. SEATTLE FD/PD ARRIVED ON SCENE AND DETERMINED THERE WERE NO INJURIES TO THE PASSENGERS OR CREW. SPS COMMAND CENTER CONFIRMED WITH WSF CAPTAIN ABOARD THE VESSEL. ALL PASSENGERS WERE EVACUATED FROM THE VESSEL, AND VEHICLES REMOVED AFTER SUCCESSFUL DOCKING AT THE FAUNTLEROY TERMINAL. 02 VEHICLES ON THE PORT SIDE REMAIN PINNED BY THE DAMAGED SUPERSTRUCTURE OF THE VESSEL. ALLISON WAS ABOVE THE WATERLINE, AND THERE IS NO POLLUTION AT THIS TIME. DOLPHIN IS ALSO SIGNIFICANTLY DAMAGED. FERRY REMAINS DOCKED AT THE FAUNTLEROY TERMINAL. CURRENT ESTIMATES ARE $500,000 OR GREATER IN DAMAGE ACCORDING TO THE PORT CAPTAIN FROM WSF, MEETING THRESHOLD FOR MAJOR MARINE CASUALTY. CASE PENDS.
